decisions.decision: Apply the provisioning profile only to the DiskSteward application target and explicitly clear it for disk-witness-mcp.
decisions.rationale: An application bundle can embed the profile authorizing App Groups, while the nested command-line executable cannot accept a provisioning profile and needs only its Developer ID signature.
